summary: Retest of three critical fixes from iteration_1: all PASSED. FIX-1 backend /api/ai/chat now returns 200 with non-empty Claude Sonnet 4.6 reply both with dict context and without context (2/2 pytest passed, live LLM responded in ~7s). FIX-2 AI Autopilot UI no longer crashes: clicking 'Quale immobile rende di meno?' returned a 1142-char Italian markdown reply in ~10s, no React error overlay, no 'Objects are not valid as a React child' error. FIX-3 SchedaImmobile tabs (anagrafica/acquisto/economico/documenti/movimenti) are all present with the new data-testid and all switch the active tabpanel correctly showing real content. Sanity-check: login with ceo@controlroom.it works and 6 sidebar voices (Dashboard, KPI, Cash Flow, Patrimonio, Mappa, AI Autopilot, Alert Center, Report Direzionali) navigate cleanly.

issues: Persistent non-fatal Recharts warning 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on first paint of ResponsiveContainer — cosmetic only, charts render. Already reported in iter_1, still present.

action_items: Optional cosmetic: silence Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warning by setting explicit min-height on the chart container parent (Dashboard.jsx / CashFlow.jsx).
Optional UX (carry-over from iter_1, not blocking): make full <tr> in Patrimonio clickable to open SchedaImmobile (currently only the property name link is clickable).
critical_code_review_comments: AIAutopilot.jsx catch block correctly normalises FastAPI 422 detail array to string before calling toast.error — defensive fix is in place and works.
Backend ChatMessageIn still types context as Optional[dict]; widening to Union[str, dict] would be a nice-to-have but no longer urgent because the frontend always sends a dict now.
session_id is generated client-side as `sess-${Date.now()}` — collision-resistant enough for demo but not unique across tabs. Consider crypto.randomUUID().
No critical bugs found in this iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three critical fixes from iteration_1 are verified resolved. AI Autopilot chat works end-to-end with Claude Sonnet 4.6 (live reply observed). SchedaImmobile tabs have data-testid='scheda-tab-{anagrafica|acquisto|economico|documenti|movimenti}' and switch content correctly. Only remaining items are cosmetic (Recharts warnings) and one UX nit (clickable row in Patrimonio).
